fire: In this triangle, the angle θ is measured in radians.
Set the parameter theta to zero before the first step.

The museum's Greek name is Εθνικό Μουσείο in the guide.
The fraternity Theta Delta Chi was founded in 1847.
The rotation is given by cos θ and sin θ in the matrix.
Each neuron has a phase theta that changes over time.
Scholars quote the phrase κατὰ τὸν θεὸν from that letter.
